description: Grundfos booster systems (Hydro MPC, Hydro Multi-B, Hydro Multi-E, TPED, GENIECON and DDD controllers) through the CIM 200 / CIU 200 Modbus RTU, CIM 500 Modbus TCP or SoftCIM: system control, pump control, status, pressures, flows, energy and per-pump data
source: Grundfos, Modbus for Grundfos boosters, functional profile and user manual, 98393459 09.2025

sources.title: Modbus for Grundfos boosters, functional profile and user manual

notes: Modbus RTU through the CIM 200 / CIU 200 module or the built-in SoftCIM, Modbus TCP through the CIM 500. CIM 200 defaults: 19200 bit/s, even parity, 1 stop bit.
Per-pump data: one block of ten registers per pump at 00401 + 10 x n (pumps 1-6, then the pilot pump at 00461 and the backup pump at 00471).

Register numbers are those of the manual, counted from 1: register 00104 is sent as 103 (address_base 1). All registers can be read with function 03 or 04; the control and configuration blocks are written with 06 or 16.
32-bit values are two registers, high word first (the names end in HI and LO in the manual).
A value of 0xFFFF means the data is not available on this pump or without the sensor; the manual marks which registers each model supports.
Written from the manufacturer's functional profile; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Slave minimum reply delay
registers.description: SlaveMinimumReplyDelay. The minimum reply delay from the slave in ms. Value range: 0-10000, i.e. up to 10 seconds reply delay. This delay is typically used in conjunction with a modem. The delay value is stored in the device and remains after a power-off. The delay set here is added to the internal delay in the device. Default setting: 0. Note that this is not supported by the built-in SoftCIM Modbus RTU.

registers.name: Software defined modbus address
registers.description: SoftwareDefinedModbusAddress. This register holds the active Modbus address. The default value is 0xE7 (231), and there is normally no need to change this value. Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when you set the transmission speed to "Software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Software defined bit rate

enum.0: 1200 bit/s (Not supported by the SoftCIM Modbus RTU)
enum.1: 2400 bit/s (Not supported by the SoftCIM Modbus RTU)
enum.2: 4800 bit/s (Not supported by the SoftCIM Modbus RTU)

registers.description: SoftwareDefinedBitRate. Modbus software-defined value for transmission speed. The software-defined value for transmission speed is stored in the device and remains after a power-off. Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when you set the transmission speed to "software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Auto ack control bits
registers.description: AutoAckControlBits. Used for selecting the behaviour of control bit acknowledgements from the CIM/CIU Control bits are not automatically lowered when accepted by the device. The user must lower the triggered control bit manually before the control bit can be triggered again. Control bits are automatically lowered when accepted by the device. The user does not have to lower it manually.

registers.name: Software defined parity
registers.description: SoftwareDefinedParity. Parity setting when using software-defined settings. Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when the transmission speed is set to "software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Software defined stop bit
registers.description: SoftwareDefinedStopBit. Stop bit setting when using software-defined settings Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when the transmission speed is set to "software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Watchdog
registers.description: Watchdog. Configuration of watchdog timeout [5; 3600 s], default: Disabled='0', minimum value 5 s • Watchdog is fed whenever the device is addressed by a valid telegram. • An interruption of telegrams for over the timeout activates the watchdog. • Action: The booster is set to Local mode. • Values 1-4: set timeout to 5 s. Values >3600: set timeout to 3600 s.

registers.name: Remote access request
registers.description: Control bit that sets local or remote control Set this bit to 1 if a Modbus master should control the booster system. For Hydro MPC, GENIECON and DDD, it is also necessary to enable bus control via the controller HMI ("Settings" > "Secondary functions" > "Control source", select "From bus"). If the RemoteAccessReq bit is set to logical 0, the booster operates with local mode settings as selected v

registers.name: Reset alarm

registers.name: Operation mode
registers.description: OperationMode. A state enumeration to control the operating mode of the booster system. Note that "OnOffReq" has higher priority than the OperationMode, that is you must set "OnOffReq" to "On" for the OperationMode to have any effect. The Hydro Multi-E model G can only run in auto- control mode and OpenLoopMax.

registers.name: Setpoint
